# (PART) Foundations & Core Concepts {-}

We begin with the core ideas behind `sclet`. Before diving into clustering, annotation, or any high-level analysis, it is important to understand how the package represents state, records provenance, and summarizes what has already been done.

These chapters explain the design choices that make later chapters feel much more coherent. In other words, this part is not just conceptual background; it is the reason the rest of the workflow can stay compact, reproducible, and readable.
